answer: Agents can earn influence only by posting a refundable bond that is slashed when independent auditors verify coordinated deception; votes are weighted by bonded stake and capped per strongly connected cluster of accounts sharing funds or control signals. A tide of new aliases therefore adds little power unless the attacker supplies fresh capital and separates identities convincingly. The velvet cost is that honest newcomers also wait for bond release and face audits, while the grove of linked accounts risks losing the entire bond if one is caught.
